summary: Quote and Depth on an NFO future: Upstox's incremental full packets are merged into the instrument's snapshot, so an LTPC-only packet, a minute-candle-only packet and a book-only packet each keep what they do not carry; volume is vtt and close the previous close.

notes: Values are the audit's P-01/P-02 probe values (WEBSOCKET_AUDIT_PRIMARY_BROKERS.md).

deviations.reason: Upstox sends OI as a double and the web passes it on as a float (98765.0); the desktop sends an integer (98765). A JSON number type is not a web defect: Lead rule 2026-11-09: this follows each broker's own web adapter (lane wire's per-broker dialect switch; bk-a sets the entry in phase B).

Upstox's book has no order counts: the web's levels carry price and quantity only and its book carries the broker's currentTs as depth.timestamp; the desktop's levels carry orders 0 (an invented zero, the 1.0.6 known limitation) and no book timestamp. Lane wire: leave orders out where the broker sends none.

The web's Upstox LTP payload names the previous close cp; A key the web sends from some mode up is sent in that mode and every mode above it, so a script reading it on the richer frame meets no KeyError (feed/dialect/names.rs rules, docs/port/market-data-frames.md).

The web's Upstox LTP payload names the last quantity ltq; A key the web sends from some mode up is sent in that mode and every mode above it, so a script reading it on the richer frame meets no KeyError (feed/dialect/names.rs rules, docs/port/market-data-frames.md).
